snippets.snippet: # JetBrains previews no-code app builder Aug 5, 2025 2 mins ... ## Called Kineto, the AI-powered platform promises to let anyone create, deploy, and maintain websites and apps without writing a single line of code. Credit: pisekar / Shutterstock JetBrains is offering early access to Kineto, an AI-powered, no-code development platform intended to help anybody create professional or personal apps regardless of technical ability. ... Launched August 5, Kineto helps users create, deploy, and maintain ready-to-use websites and small “single-value” apps without writing a single line of code, JetBrains said. These apps could include a portfolio website, a family budget planner, or the next big app, the company noted. Interested participants can join the waitlist at kineto.dev. snippets.title: Kinetik launches AI team agent for influencer marketing campaigns
snippets.snippet: Kineto launched Kinetik For Teams, an AI agent that runs influencer campaigns from Slack and WhatsApp, starting at $50 per month. The tool, trusted by 10,000 creators, automates discovery, outreach, and reporting for teams of 1 to 100 people. ... Published on: Aug 15, 2026 ... Kineto, an AI company spun out of JetBrains, has launched Kinetik For Teams, an AI agent that runs influencer and content marketing campaigns from inside Slack and WhatsApp. The tool, introduced publicly on Aug. 13, handles creator discovery, outreach, briefs, content creation, and reporting, and is already trusted by 10,000 creators. Kinetik is designed for in-house marketing teams that want to run influencer programs without building a dedicated department. ... Kinetik For Teams is available now at kineto.app/for-business. Subscription plans cover teams of 1 to 100 people, with pricing starting at $50 per month.
